contract: ⑤ (quality_ideas §1, 검수 2026-10-07): PvPService.Protect (spawn, 10 s) keeps the ForceField (Humanoid:TakeDamage still respects it) but Visible = false, and puts a Highlight "ProtectGlow" on the body: no fill (FillTransparency 1), OutlineColor = Config.Factions[faction].Color (Halo gold, Horns red), OutlineTransparency = Config.PvP.ProtectGlow.OutlineTransparency (0.35), DepthMode Occluded. One shield, one outline. The outline goes with the shield (BreakProtection after the protected player's hit, the expiry in the 1 s loop); while protected the loop puts it back on a rebuilt body (an appearance swap moves the ForceField, not the outline), and a cosmetic spawn never renews the time. The Protected attribute (the 'Revive Shield' chip) is unchanged.
limitations: The real look (outline width, how it reads on avatars at a distance, phone) needs a Studio check by game dev 1. Roblox draws at most 31 Highlights at once per client; spawn shields last 10 s, so only a few exist at a time. A body that also wears the 3-star WantedGlow shows both Highlights.
